title: Accept agent-written code only with a deterministic hard gate; optional JEV judge for holdout and meaning-level metamorphic checks
confidence_notes: PCM durable write covers the TypeSafe JEV contract and an OpenRouter Decisions smoke. Live holdout execution and confidence calibration remain open, so treat JEV pass rates as provisional.
hypothesis_notice: Hypothesis components: live holdout runner, catalogue availability of typesafe/jev, and calibration against known-good/bad packs. Deterministic hard gates are mandatory even while those remain open.

deterministic_hard_gate.notes: Mechanical and spec checks must pass. Do not substitute JEV for deterministic coverage.

optional_jev_judge.notes: Abstain, uncertain, parse, and provider errors count as not pass. Never promote JEV outputs to objective gold. Staff must never see holdout contents.
